name: Marisha
notes: Deep trust. She oversees the household granary and planning — he trusts her judgment over his own during shortages.

name: Somadatta
notes: Worried about him. Thinks he is too soft and easily distracted by stories.

name: Balamitra
notes: Respectful but frustrated. Believes leadership sometimes ignores practical limits.

name: Nara
notes: Politely distant. Thinks temple decisions sometimes ignore the reality of hunger.

name: Satyapala
notes: Occasional cooperation on timber and land boundaries, but tension over land use.
